item.title: Historic Roggeland farmstead damaged in ongoing wildfire crisis
item.description: Another historic Cape Winelands site has been damaged after a runaway veld fire destroyed part of the centuries-old Roggeland farm near Paarl, as firefighters remain stretched battling multiple wildfires across the region.

item.title: Kruger National Park Reopens to Day Visitors After Floods, Northern Areas Still Closed
item.description: Recent floods at South Africa's Kruger National Park have forced wildlife to seek higher ground, with viral videos showing animals, including crocodiles, searching for refuge.

item.title: Sunrisers win a thriller at St George's Park to eliminate defending champions MI Cape Town
item.description: Sunrisers Eastern Cape duo Chris Green and Matthew Breetzke were the heroes for the home team at St George's Park on Sunday.

item.title: Flower petals showered on devotees as thousands take holy dip on Mauni Amavasya
item.description: Hindu devotees offer prayers and take a holy dip in Sangam, the confluence of Ganges, Yamuna and mythical Saraswati rivers, on the occasion of 'Mauni Amavasya' observed during the Magh Mela festival in Prayagraj today.

item.title: Lavender Hill woman with vocal cord palsy finally scheduled for surgery assessment
item.description: The provincial surgical backlog stands at 99,979 patients, with 87,975 waiting over a year and 20,027 over 60 months.

item.title: India's ODI series defeat: Shubman Gill reflects on performance against New Zealand
item.description: New Zealand's players pose with the trophy after winning the One Day International cricket series against India at the Holkar Cricket Stadium in Indore today.

item.title: IN PICTURES | Senegal v Morocco: A night of grandeur ahead of AFCON final
item.description: Senegal's midfielder Pathe Ciss arrives prior the Africa Cup of Nations final between Senegal and Morocco at the Prince Moulay Abdellah Stadium in Rabat on Sunday. Photo: AFP

item.title: Court rules arrest for speeding unlawful: high-speed motorist wins case against traffic officers
item.description: A WESTERN Cape High Court ruling has declared that arresting motorists for speeding without a warrant is unlawful and unconstitutional, even in cases of excessive speeding.

item.title: Heartbreak for Cheetahs as Racing 92 snatch late victory in Paris
item.description: In Champions Cup action Sunday night, Harlequins beat La Rochelle 27-17 in the Stade Marcel-Deflandre in La Rochelle, France. Here, Harlequins flanker Tom Lawday dives over the whitewash to score a try during the match. Photo: AFP

item.title: Fire incidents in Cape Town rise sharply as emergency services struggle
item.description: Fire incidents surge across Cape Town, with vegetation and residential blazes up by as much as 16% year on year, placing growing pressure on emergency services as officials urge residents to step up fire prevention.
